meta.name: baoyu-post-to-x
meta.description: Posts content and articles to X (Twitter). Supports regular posts with images/videos and X Articles (long-form Markdown). In Codex, honor explicit requests for the Codex Chrome plugin/@chrome by using the Chrome Extension workflow; otherwise use Chrome Computer Use when available and fall back to real Chrome CDP scripts only when allowed. Use when user asks to "post to X", "tweet", "publish to Twitter", or "share on X".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动将内容发布到 X 平台
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要定时或即时将文章推送到 X 账号。
copy.tagline_en: Automatically post content to X platform
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to schedule or instantly push articles to your X account.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会用你真实的 Chrome 浏览器把文字、图片、视频或 Markdown 长文发到 X(Twitter);发帖前先把内容填进编辑框,等你确认才点发布。
howto.when: 当你说「post to X」「tweet」「publish to Twitter」等说法,或要发布 Markdown 长文时接管;没指定则默认走 Chrome 操作。

say.text: 帮我把这条发到 X:今天天气不错
say.note: 它打开 Chrome 填好内容,等你确认再发布
图片和文字一起填入发帖框

say.text: 把 article.md 发布成 X Article
say.note: 先转 Markdown,再上传封面和正文图

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude posts text, images, videos, or long-form Markdown articles to X (Twitter) through your real Chrome browser, filling in the composer and waiting for your confirmation before publishing.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "post to X", "tweet", or "publish to Twitter", or ask to publish a Markdown .md article; with no stated mode it defaults to Chrome control.

say_en.text: Post this to X for me: the weather is nice today
say_en.note: It opens Chrome, fills the composer, waits for your confirmation
Image and text go into the composer together

say_en.text: Publish article.md as an X Article
say_en.note: Converts the Markdown, then uploads cover and body images
